data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the start of the year were GBP 458.0m. Using the syndicate's published gross claims development table, there was a net adverse prior-year development of GBP 10.1m (2.2% of opening gross reserves) driven predominantly by adverse development on older reinsurance-acceptance exposures and exacerbated by inflationary pressures and large-loss development. The syndicate cites recent natural catastrophe activity (eg Hurricane Ian) and rising insured values/inflation as market drivers; the quantified PYD above is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (excluding the two most recent underwriting years).
raw_causal_phrases: The combination of Hurricane Ian in 2022, increasing inflationary pressure on insured values and a withdrawal of reinsurance capacity for property catastrophe risk has materially hardened the market for 2023 year of account, and we would expect this to continue throughout the year and into 2024.
there is always a risk that the assumptions and techniques used in these models are unreliable or that claims arising from an unmodelled event are greater than those arising from a modelled event.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (10.1) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative gross claims by UW year) by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for UW years 2013-2020 and summing the changes. No explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities column) was found in narrative notes; exact_reserve_text is therefore empty. RITC activity and reinsurance placements were reviewed; no clear RITC distortion of the gross triangle for prior-year columns was identified in the annual accounts. LOB attribution for the PYD is inferred (Treaty/Reinsurance) based on the syndicate's predominant business mix; amounts by LOB are not quantified in the report.
